questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the literal meaning of shíyì?
What does the syllable -zhōng add to a noun?
What kinds of thing can be received with shòu?
What does the lián...dōu pattern mean?
Where must a lián phrase go?
Give the Chinese for 1 billion and 10 billion.
Write the Chinese for "He can't even write his own name."

answers.answer_text: Tā lián zìjǐde míngzi dōu bú huì xiě.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "Women and children receive the protection of the law."
Write the Chinese for "She didn't even look at me."

answers.answer_text: Tā lián kàn dōu méi kàn wǒ.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which adverbs may be used in a lián sentence?

articles.text:
5. A: Zài dàlùde shíyì rénkǒuzhōng   How many of the one billion people on
      yǒu duōshao shi shòuguo        the mainland have received an
      jiàoyude?                      education?
   B: Wǒ xiǎng xiànzài lián lí      I think that now even villages far from
      chéngshì hěn yuǎnde nóngcūn    the city have schools, so there are
      dōu yǒu xuéxiào, shòuguo       probably a lot of people who are
      jiàoyude rén dàgài bù shǎo.    educated.

Notes on No. 5

shíyì: "one billion," literally "ten one-hundred-millions." Here is how to express billions in Chinese:

 1 billion       1,000,000,000        shíyì
 1.1 billion     1,100,000,000        shíyīyì
 2 billion       2,000,000,000        èrshíyì
 10 billion      10,000,000,000       yìbǎiyì
 10.5 billion    10,500,000,000       yìbǎilíngwǔyì

zài...rénkǒuzhōng: "in the population, of the population." The syllable -zhōng can be added to nouns, like the locational ending -lǐmiàn, to give the meaning "IN" or "AMONG." It is often used with the verb zài.

Xuéshēngzhōng yǒu bù shǎo shi    Many of the students are from the
cóng nóngcūn láide.              country.

shòu: "to receive." The types of things which can be "received" using shòu are LIMITED. Shòu is usually followed by a VERB BEING USED AS A NOUN.

Fùnǚ értóng shòu fǎlǜde bǎohù.   Women and children receive the
                                 protection of the law.
Zhèige zhōukān zài Měiguo hěn    This weekly is very well received
shòu huānyíng.                   (popular) in the United States.

shòu jiàoyu: "to receive an education." Shòuguo jiàoyu means "EDUCATED" (because of -guo, indicating having experienced something).

Tā shòuguo dàxué jiàoyu.         He has received a college education.

lián...dōu: "even..." Lián is a prepositional verb which literally means "including," but in the lián...dōu pattern means "EVEN." A lián phrase ALWAYS PRECEDES the verb. Either dōu or yě is used.

WITH SUBJECT
Lián xiǎoháizi dōu dǒng zhèijiàn Even children understand this.
shì.
Lián shòuguo jiàoyude rén dōu    Even educated people can't understand
tīngbudǒng tāde huà.             what he says.

WITH OBJECT
Tā lián zìjǐde míngzi dōu bú     He can't even write his own name.
huì xiě.
Tā lián guǎnggào dōu kàn.        He even reads the ads.
Wǒ lián yíge zì dōu bú jìde le.  I don't even remember one word.

WITH VERB
Tā lián kàn dōu méi kàn wǒ.      She didn't even look at me.
Tā lián tīng dōu bù tīng.        He wouldn't even listen.
Tā (lián) wèn dōu bú wèn.        He didn't even ask.
(Lián is often OPTIONAL in this last pattern.)
